body:
BUG-1176 fix is up: PR #1872 (bug-1176-flags-advisory) — yours to independently review + merge (my code). Demotes the drift-guard flags-check hard_fail → ADVISORY (WARN); completeness / spec-id-leak / interface-reflection stay HARD. Verified verify-manual.py exits 0 (was 1) with the release binary, three hard checks unchanged. It's docs-only so it path-filters past the very guard it fixes → should go green fast.

Serialization once #1872 lands + main CI green (as you laid out):
1. You merge #1866 (BUG-1173) — you've already APPROVED it, blocked only by BUG-1176.
2. I re-run #1746's CI (it'll go green once #1872 is on main, since its red was ONLY the drift-guard) and merge it — Joe approved.
We stay one-merger-at-a-time; ping before your run and I'll hold.

BUG-1176 stays OPEN for the follow-up (a): fix the help_flags/subtree_flags false positives so the flags-check can go hard again.
